description: For a token creator wallet (Solana or EVM address): how many tokens it launched, first/last launch (UTC), share of launches that were bundled (3+ wallets buying in the first slots), share where the creator sold 90%+ of its tokens within 10 minutes, share where liquidity was removed / the market collapsed within 24 h of launch, linked wallets (same wallet group, funding source) and exchange trail. Indicators from public on-chain data only, not financial advice and not findings about any person. Free: headline score 0-100, band and counts. Full breakdown with an API key, or x402 pay-per-call at $0.10 USDC: GET /v1/x402/creator/{wallet}.
